critical_code_review_comments: ClientReport.jsx:35 persist() fires a PUT /advisor/branding on every keystroke of firm_name AND cover_note — carryover from iter9. Debounce ~300ms would materially reduce API chatter while typing the cover note.

AdvisorClients.jsx buildBookPdf: no handling for jsPDF add-page overflow of a long per-household block — if a household's alert line wraps or there are >~40 rows, lines can run under the footer area. Current MVP has 3 clients so this is latent; consider doc.splitTextToSize + checking y>268 after each line, not just at loop top.

AdvisorClients.jsx buildBookPdf header shows the user's existing book-level firm name/branding is NOT inlined — the Book Review PDF uses hard-coded 'Book Review' title; could reuse brand.firm_name from /advisor/branding for brand consistency with the single-household PDF.

ClientReport.jsx history drill-in: when history row's sent_at is null/undefined, `new Date(undefined).toLocaleString()` renders 'Invalid Date' in the modal. Guard with `historyModal.sent_at ? new Date(...).toLocaleString() : '—'`.
email_service.py render_report_html still reads EMAIL_FROM_NAME and EMAIL_KEY at import time — missing env would crash backend on boot. Already noted iter9; still unresolved.

Goals.jsx requiredMonthly: when target_year is in the past (ty < current year), n is clamped to 1 so suggestion becomes ~ (target - current) in a single month (e.g. $999,900/mo), which is noisy. Add 'overdue' label or cap suggestion when target_year < now.

Goals.jsx applyFix rounds to Math.round(req) — fine, but when req is very large (hundreds of thousands) you may want to also bump growth_rate or warn the user that the suggested contribution is unrealistic rather than silently save.
ClientReport.jsx download() PDF Estate section: when beneficiaries + documents are both 0, prints 'No estate register entries.' but the three KPI lines are always printed; good, matches UI.
